name: Staff of Charming
description: A slender staff of pale wood twined with carved flowers.
attuned_by: by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
body:
## What it does

Spend its charges to charm, command or understand those you meet. Once a day, when you fail a saving throw against an enchantment spell that targets only you, you can succeed instead, and whenever you succeed on such a save you can spend a charge to turn the spell back on its caster.

## Charges

It holds ten and regains 1d8 + 2 each dawn. Spend the last and it may become a plain staff.

features.name: Reflect
features.text: Once per dawn, turn a failed save against an enchantment spell that targets only you into a success. When you succeed on such a save, spend a charge as a reaction to turn the spell back on its caster.

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 it becomes a nonmagical quarterstaff
